# iVibe

> iVibe is an open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that turns your voice, and your screen when it helps, into text pasted where you were typing. Show a bug and say what's wrong, and it writes a prompt for your coding agent, with marked-up screenshots as proof. Licensed AGPL-3.0.

It needs the internet, because speech and cleanup run on Meta's models. It's free with your own Meta key or 50 free credits. Pro is $8 a month for 400 credits.

## Docs

- [What is iVibe?](https://ivibe.tech/docs): the three modes and where to start
- [Install](https://ivibe.tech/docs/install): Windows, macOS and Linux
- [Fix](https://ivibe.tech/docs/fix): turn a bug on screen into a prompt
- [Prompt](https://ivibe.tech/docs/prompt): turn a spoken idea into a prompt
- [Dictate](https://ivibe.tech/docs/dictate): clean voice typing in any app
- [Plans and credits](https://ivibe.tech/docs/plans): keys, credits and Pro
- [Privacy and security](https://ivibe.tech/docs/privacy): what's hidden and what reaches Meta
